name: EZ-Bar Reverse Preacher Curl
cues: Rest your upper arms flat on the preacher pad
Hold the bar palms down on its angled grips
Keep your wrists in line with your forearms
Lower until your elbows are almost straight

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. needs work: The upper arm floats off the pad, which contradicts cue 1 ('upper arms flat on the pad'). The elbow moves 31 mm along the pad normal (sh·n 0.921 fixed, el·n 0.920 to 0.890), so after the 5 mm sink it sits about 26 mm above the pad for the top half of the rep. Humeral rotation also swings -6 to 38 deg (44 deg) and the elevation moves 5 deg. It has the same half-off-edge elbow placement as 720 (x ±0.26 on a 0.28 half-width pad).
